ORA Resources for PIs

From the ORA eTraining module "Post Award Quick Guide" (lesson 7 of 9).
Resources Available in ORA
ORA Resources
The Office of Research Administration (ORA) aims at providing research oversight and superb service to MSU researchers and their partners. With that mission in mind, we are continuously working on providing greater utility and resources to the talented research faculty/staff on our campus. Below are some examples of the resources already available with more to come! If there are questions beyond the answers the resources below can provide, those may be sent to ask.ora@morgan.edu. Questions sent to ask.ora@morgan.edu are either answered directly or forwarded to the appropriate office within Morgan State University (MSU) in a timely manner.
Time to read!
PI Handbooks: With topics ranging from pre-award budget preparation to IRB and IACUC requirements, PI Handbooks #1-5 detail nearly every aspect of the administration of your project.
https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/resources/principal-investigator-handbooks
Training Awaits!
E-Trainings: The ORA is pleased to provide a gamut of training modules touching on all aspects of administrative functions here at MSU. Check back regularly for future training opportunities on functions such as purchasing card usage, budget queries, contract entry for employees, and much more!
https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/trainings/e-training
View Content!
Presentations/Slides/Videos: Recordings of past DRED/ORA seminars, special workshops, and faculty development seminars are just a click away!
https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/trainings
Review Forms Here!
Post-Award Forms ORA has worked on, and will continue to draft, DocuSign forms for grant-related post award actions such as contract entry, travel requests, etc.
https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/post-award/forms
Meet Our Team!
ORA Staff Directory The Office of Research Administration has cultivated a group of subject matter experts to advise you on your project both pre and post-award.
https://www.morgan.edu/office-of-research-administration/about/staff-directory
Complete the content above before moving on.
